prompt:
Close framing: a young man of twenty-five photographed from the waist up
only, his head and torso filling most of a vertical frame, cropped at the
waist. He stands on a Berlin pavement on a weekday morning, turned three
quarters to his right so that both his eyes and most of both cheeks stay
visible. He wears a plain navy blue pique polo shirt with a short buttoned placket, the chest smooth and unmarked, and beige chino trousers. The placket buttons are red, a small warm accent against the blue. Behind him the pavement runs on with a broad red-painted bicycle
strip beside a grey pedestrian strip, bicycles parked against a plain pale
building front, and a pedestrian traffic light further along the street
showing a RED standing figure. Daylight, overcast and even. He looks at a
point beyond the right edge of the frame and does not face the camera.
